policy: No image is usable for a building GLB until the actual image is visually inspected and exact target identity is confirmed.

reasons: The image is a broad roadside scene rather than a verified view of a specific target building.
The main wall/building is seen at a distance and provides insufficient facade detail for faithful texturing or reconstruction.
The vehicle mirror occupies a large part of the foreground and the image does not establish the target building identity or facade orientation.

reviews.allowed_use: Area context only; do not use as a building texture, facade decal, or geometry source.

approval_rule: Only records with decision approved_exact_building and a non-null target building identity may be used for the specifically documented visible facade. Rejected, partial, unknown, or unreviewed images must never be used to generate or texture a building GLB.
